$comment: $id is a logical identifier only. Validators should not dereference it as a network URL.
title: agentbootup Brain Bundle v1
description: L1 portable brain manifest. Evolved additively from agentbootup.json v2 while remaining environment-agnostic. This schema is reference-only for credentials and does not prescribe secret storage.

brainId.description: Stable brain identifier. Must remain stable across mount/unmount.

credential_references.description: References to credentials only. Raw secret values, private keys, API tokens, and passwords are forbidden by the agentbootup validator.

toolsets.description: Environment-scoped toolset capability contract. Keyed by environment id (e.g. circle_computer, mac-mini, macbook-pro-5); each value is a per-environment allowlist/disabled_toolsets policy. pi-package selection is NOT here — it is a mech-plane routing concern.

disabled_toolsets.description: Toolsets explicitly disabled in this environment
